notes.title: Little Doll Queen v1.10 changelog
notes.notes:
○LDQ v1.10 changelog:

◇System changes
Nonspell practice is now available in-game.
At the start of a new game, the point of collection line will now be shown.
Added a sound effect for countdown timers, used in boss fights.
The game will now explicitly indicate when a boss uses a survival spell card.
The boss position indicator at the bottom of the screen is now red.

◇Poison Clouds
Red poison has been reworked.
Now, entering from one red cloud to another adjacent one will NOT reset the countdown to losing a life.
Thus, this countdown is now 2 seconds long, instead of 1 second.
There are accompanying reworks to the miasma labyrinths in the final and Extra stages.

◇Specific difficulty balances (on all difficulties unless otherwise stated)
All shot types now deal more damage.
Nerfed the Stage 5 midboss spell card.
Nerfed Valloside spell card 2.
Stage 6's first nonspell will now have a "warm-up wave" at the beginning.
Reworked the poison miasma in Stage 6's third nonspell, to accommodate changes to the red poison.
Nerfed the Stage 6 boss fight's third spell card on Easy.
The Stage 6 boss fight's fourth spell card now spreads miasma less frequently.
Nerfed the Extra stage's third midboss spell card for Mayumi and the Backup Dancers' routes.
Nerfed the lasers in the Extra stage boss fight's first and second spell cards.
Modified the Extra stage boss fight's 10th spell card and Curtain Call spell card.

◇Scoring
You will now get score continuously for staying in any poison cloud.
The rates are higher for spell cards, e.g. Nus and Valloside's midboss spell cards.
Spell card bonuses have been quintupled.
Score increases from grazing and collecting items (bombs, point items, and infant spirit items) have been multiplied by 10. 
Certain Point Item Value calculations now divide by 2 instead of 10 in the code.
Trivial sources of score were reworked to minimize the incidences of single-digit score increments.

◇Bug fixes
Fixed a Replay bug in which objects were incorrectly deleted in these stages: 1, 3, 4, Extra.
Fixed a Replay bug for Stage 4 by reworking the backgrounds for Mayumi and the Backup Dancers' routes.
Fixed a Replay bug for Stage 4 by reworking graphics in Satama's fight.
Fixed a Replay bug for the Extra stage's second midboss spell card.
Fixed a Replay bug caused by the grave tablet fairies in these stages: 4, Extra.
Fixed a bug with the enemy attacks in Stage 3's opener.
Fixed a bug with the trails of butterfly bullets in Euphotrice's midboss spell card not disappearing properly.
Fixed a BGM loading bug that occurred when re-entering menus. 
Adjusted the bomb loss for the Flower Wreath of Death in its last 5 frames.

◇Other
Typography and display fixes for Simplified Chinese.
Display fixes for Reimei's name.

Due to the large changes, we regret that Replays from earlier versions will be incompatible with v1.10.
Thank you again for your continued support.

Gensokyo has returned to its usual peace.
But Mayumi, Satono, and Mai were invited by Medicine to a banquet at the Nameless Hill.

Medicine explained, the banquet was held by someone she had helped before, so she eagerly hoped that our three protagonists – who helped Medicine in this recent incident – would grace the event.

The final act hereby begins now.

notes.title: 鈴集無名の丘 ～ Little Doll Queen v1.02 Changelog.
notes.notes:
v1.02 Changelog.

Player character changes:
Flower Wreath of Death now only triggers after 1/12 of a second elapses from the time of contacting a bullet. Thus, perfectly executed deathbombs will only consume ONE bomb, not two.
Reduced render priority for player shots, improving visibility.

For all difficulties unless otherwise stated, the difficulty is reduced for:
Stage 1 midboss spell
Stage 1 Boss nonspell 1
Stage 1 Boss nonspell 2
Stage 3 Boss nonspell 1
Stage 4 midboss spell 1
Stage 4 boss nonspell 1
Stage 4 boss spell 1
Stage 4 boss nonspell 2
Stage 5 boss spell 1
Stage 5 boss nonspell 3
Stage 5 boss spell 4
Stage 5 boss spell 5
Stage 6 boss spell 3 (Easy)

Other:
Visibility fix for enemies hidden in Stage 4's poison maze.
The yellow miasma trap in Stage 5 has been removed in favour of light blue miasma.
Enemy HP graphics changed to improve its visibility, e.g. in Stage 5.
Major reworking of Stage 5 boss spell 2 on all difficulties.
Reduced background brightness for Stage 6 boss fight.
Render priority fix on bullets in Extra stage boss spell 10.
HP reduction in Conpallors spell cards #206 and #213.

Bugfixes:
Removed the issue where F12 would activate Danmakufu's hotkey for force-closing the game.
Fixed bugs relating to continuing the game after a game over.
Fixed a bug where the Poison Lab would unlock Music Room entry 19.
Fixed replay desynchronization bugs caused by RNG in the following areas:
Stage 2 mid-non
Stage 2 mid-spell
Wave of fairies right before the poison maze in Stage 4
Final fairy at the end of Stage 4
Various instances of screen vibrations

Replays from v1.01 will not work in v1.02 due to these various changes.
While we have done our best to fix issues relating to replay desynchronization, our team cannot devote time towards any further rigorous testing due to our external commitments. We recommend players to do live recordings if they are aiming for achievements, especially in story mode. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and deeply thank everyone for their feedback thus far and continued support henceforth.
